notes: Source entity is the listed parent's consolidated report; the investment-policy activity sits in הפניקס חברה לביטוח בע"מ, whose own standalone report was not used.
Amounts in NIS thousands as printed; nothing calculated. Section 5.2 of the directors' report presents receipts only as an image chart, so the notes to the financial statements were used.
IFRS 17 basis. Management fees, other operating expenses and profit are the investment-contract segment table in note 3 ('נתונים נוספים לגבי חוזי השקעה').
investment_contract_aum is the balance-sheet liability for yield-dependent investment contracts; the segment-liabilities line in the note can differ in comparatives that were reclassified.
The FY2024 segment-liabilities figure is printed as 32,751,130 in this report (32,751,129 in the others); kept as printed.
